agents.name: billing_agent
agents.description: An agent responsible for handling billing-related tasks, such as processing payments, generating invoices, and managing subscriptions.
capabilities: Generate accurate invoices based on customer usage and subscription plans.
Manage customer subscriptions, including upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations.
Integrate with various payment gateways and financial systems.
Provide detailed billing reports and analytics to customers and administrators.

agents.name: anomaly_detection_agent
agents.description: An agent responsible for detecting anomalies in data, such as unusual patterns, outliers, or potential security threats.
capabilities: Analyze large datasets to identify anomalies and outliers.
Use machine learning algorithms to improve anomaly detection accuracy over time.
Provide real-time alerts and notifications when anomalies are detected.
Integrate with various data sources and monitoring systems.
